mods.name: wrapped
mods.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

mods.name: streaks
mods.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

mods.name: achievements
mods.description: Unlocks eight badges once each (first session, first green test run, 100 and 1,000 tool calls, 7-day streak, 10 blocked calls, a 2 hour session, night owl), with a toast and /achievements.

mods.name: stats-pack
mods.description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.
